## New Safety Measures for Dubai School Transport

As the new academic year approaches, [Dubai](https://www.schoolsery.com/schools?location=Dubai) is implementing improved transport options and stringent safety measures for students. The Roads and Transport Authority (RTA) has outlined several initiatives aimed at enhancing the safety and reliability of school journeys, addressing parent concerns and ensuring a smoother commute for students.

### Enhanced Transport Options

Starting with the 2026-27 academic year, students in Dubai will benefit from a broader selection of transport services. RTA is introducing dedicated school mobility services, which include partnerships with e-hail limousine operators offering safe transport options. These services will feature safety-rated drivers and modern vehicle fleets, thereby increasing the variety of choices available for families.

In addition to traditional school buses, students will now have access to services such as Careem School Rides, Uber Teens, and BOLT School. A ride-pooling initiative available through the Yango app is also being introduced, allowing students to share rides, which can be both cost-effective and convenient for families.

### Comprehensive Safety Checks

To ensure the safety of students, RTA has mandated comprehensive safety checks for all school transport operators. This includes verifying that buses are fully operational and that permits for drivers and attendants are current. The authority plans to conduct a 30-day intensive inspection campaign that will examine compliance with safety standards and operational procedures across the transport services.

The increased focus on safety extends to mandatory seat belt use on school buses and during ride-hailing services. This is in line with RTA's commitment to safeguarding the school community and enhancing overall transport safety.

### Increased Public Transport Capacity

To further support families, RTA is increasing the frequency of more than 30 bus routes servicing key school areas, including Al Nahda, Muhaisnah, Al Barsha, Al Quoz, Dubai Silicon Oasis, and Al Garhoud. These additions are expected to improve service availability, reduce waiting times, and make school journeys more manageable for students and their families.

### Implications for Parents

The new measures being introduced by RTA reflect a proactive approach to addressing the needs of families in Dubai. With a broader range of transport options and enhanced safety protocols, parents can feel more assured about their children's daily commutes. The introduction of ride-sharing and ride-pooling options also offers flexibility and potentially lower costs, making school transport more accessible.

Furthermore, as [schools](https://www.schoolsery.com/schools) prepare for the return of students, there will be an increased emphasis on health and safety protocols within the educational environment. Schools are expected to utilise the pre-term period for comprehensive staff training on safeguarding and health measures, ensuring a safe and secure atmosphere upon students' arrival.

In summary, these developments signify a commitment to improving the overall educational experience for families in Dubai. With the new academic year just around the corner, these enhancements in school transport and safety measures will undoubtedly support a smoother transition back to school for students and their parents alike.
